title: Tests are plain Node with no framework: PASS/FAIL lines, 'N passed, M failed', exit nonzero
summary: The ~150 files in test/ use no test framework. Each requires the target module directly (e.g. require('../daemon.js')), prints 'PASS <label>'/'FAIL <label>' lines, ends with 'N passed, M failed', and process.exit(fail===0?0:1). New tests must follow this shape rather than reaching for jest/mocha.
